title: How do I increase my Everyone Pay sending limit?
summary: Explains how to increase your Everyone Pay sending limit: go to Account Settings → request a limit increase, describe typical payment volumes/purpose and the limit you want, and allow up to 4 days for review/processing. Also covers temporary boosts (up to 30.0% of your current limit) and whether automatic increases are enabled (True/False).
